27: def compile_patterns(patterns: list[str]) -> list[re.Pattern[str]]:
28:     return [re.compile(pattern) for pattern in patterns]

31: def matches_any(path: str, patterns: list[re.Pattern[str]]) -> bool:
32:     return any(pattern.search(path) for pattern in patterns)

35: def git_changed_files(base: str, head: str) -> list[str]:
36:     diff_ref = f"{base}...{head}"
37:     result = subprocess.run(
38:         ["git", "diff", "--name-only", diff_ref],
39:         check=True,
40:         capture_output=True,
41:         text=True,
42:     )
43:     files = [line.strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
44:     return sorted(set(files))

47: def load_go_package_roots(config: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
48:     configured = config.get("go_package_roots")
49:     if configured is None:
50:         raise SystemExit(
51:             "Missing required 'go_package_roots' in test map configuration."
52:         )
53:     if not isinstance(configured, list) or not all(
54:         isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() for item in configured
55:     ):
56:         raise SystemExit(
57:             "'go_package_roots' must be a non-empty list of non-empty strings."
58:         )
59:     return {item.strip() for item in configured}

62: def normalize_go_package(path: str, go_package_roots: set[str]) -> str | None:
63:     p = Path(path)
64: 
65:     if p.suffix != ".go":
66:         return None
67: 
68:     if not p.parts or p.parts[0] not in go_package_roots:
69:         return None
70: 
71:     return f"./{p.parent}"

    config: dict[str, Any], changed_files: list[str], base: str, head: str

    ignore_patterns = compile_patterns(config.get("ignore_patterns", []))
    docs_patterns = compile_patterns(config.get("docs_only_patterns", []))
    fallback_patterns = compile_patterns(config.get("fallback_patterns", []))

    ]

    )

    selected_pytest_files: set[str] = set()

    reasons: list[str] = []

    smoke_pytest = set(smoke.get("pytest_files", []))

    rule_match_by_file: dict[str, list[str]] = {path: [] for path in considered_files}
    for rule in config.get("rules", []):
        compiled_rule_patterns = compile_patterns(rule.get("patterns", []))
        matched = [
            path for path in considered_files if matches_any(path, compiled_rule_patterns)
        ]
        if not matched:
            continue
        matched_rules.append(rule["id"])
        selected_go_packages.update(rule.get("go_packages", []))
        selected_pytest_files.update(rule.get("pytest_files", []))
        reasons.append(f"rule:{rule['id']}")
        for path in matched:
            rule_match_by_file[path].append(rule["id"])

            selected_go_packages.add(package)
            reasons.append(f"derived-go-package:{package}")

        path for path in considered_files if matches_any(path, fallback_patterns)
    ]
    run_full_integration = bool(full_run_triggers)

        run_full_integration = True
        reasons.append("no-considered-files")
